services.name: Kayak Rental
services.desc: Online booking suggested! Try our early bird special between 9am and 11am and rent for only $20! About Whether you’re searching for El Dorado or discovering America, a kayak is required. An expedition just doesn’t feel right without a kayak. This is where your journey begins. Grab a friend, your swimsuit, and your binoculars. Who even uses those anymore? During your kayak adventure, you’ll paddle past impressive yachts, beautiful homes, and maybe even a manatee. services.name: SUP Rental
services.desc: Online booking suggested. Try our early bird special between 9am and 11am and rent for only $20! About Paddle Boards offer ease of use, performance, and fun for everyone! With ample width, the Paddle Boards are very stable for riders up to 230lbs on the 10’8, or 180lbs on the 10’2 board in flat water, river paddling, or surf. Paddle Boards is the ideal board for a wide range of riders and offers the option of paddling with your child or dog on the board as well. The attendants can position you in prime beach location so you can maximize your suntan time or they can put you in a spot where you can enjoy the endless ocean view from many different angles. You can’t go wrong basking under the sun while relaxing on a comfortable lounge chair and one of our beach-type umbrellas.
